items.earned_basis: 5/6: audited rolling collector, local collection archive, PostgreSQL base contract, individual-journal importer, and now atomic collection import with permanent parent revocation executed on PostgreSQL 18.6 in native Termux. Collection evidence verifies 33 SQL checks, actual permissions, concurrent writers, second-window rollback, interrupted-client rollback/retry, all original rows, receipts, eligibility views and orderly restart. The remaining point requires operational collector/database connection, remote storage/broker/workflow integration, prolonged operation, observability and joint recovery. No operational phase exit is closed. Native local-client evidence now also audited: 17 checks, 16 attempts, lost acknowledgment/retry, precommit timeout, revocations, exact rows and restart. A bounded collector/archive/sync worker is implemented and tested with real Rust/Polars and explicit RPC/SQL doubles, including actual worker-lock SIGKILL recovery. Full worker real-service integration remains pending; no extra point is awarded.
